items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: On a fresh retry the green HTTP candidate passed its gate and the cycle passed; the eleven recorded effects were stamp, pin, checklist, self-check, fence, regenerate, install, self-check, gate, file-verdicts and file-score in order.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed at the fence, a second start of R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the progress list contained R-1 once for C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: During a sleeping builder session, R-2 was refused run-in-progress; R-2 progress was null while R-1 progress was running.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 passed, starting R-2 for C-1 was refused cycle-already-run and R-2 progress was null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A start with a nonexistent commit was refused with not-a-commit; run-progress returned null, and no builder was configured or launched.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: An empty scenario plan produced a refused checklist effect with empty-checklist, then halted at checklist with no self-check or fence effects.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: The unstamped extra scenario was assigned 01-003; the recorded stamp was followed by a stamp halt for differing identities, with no pin or checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The failing self-check recorded golden checklist differs; the run failed at fence for harness-self-check-failed without a fence or regenerate effect.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The first self-check passed and recorded skipped-checks containing bb-tools.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: The absent harness/cycles path caused fence refusal fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by fail-cycle and failure at fence for fence-refused; no builder ran.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: The builder observed one commit, plan and config, no fenced paths in reachable objects, and gitlink provided-runtime mode 160000 with the cut target object ID.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder log showed two distinct session identities, with the first end recorded before the second start; the first red candidate was repaired and the second passed.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder copied a candidate and exited 1; regenerate recorded its digest and the gate and cycle passed.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder left the candidate scope empty; fail-cycle was recorded and the cycle failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated without a regenerate effect.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: On a fresh retry the two-second timeout produced a regenerate-stage budget failure; the builder recorded PID 32340, which the active process sample observed and the after sample no longer found.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: With a server already on the port, the gate refused seam-answered-before-boot three times with a gate-refusal after each; the cycle failed for infrastructure and the candidate launch marker was absent.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A red suite produced a recorded suite-red gate failure, the launch marker was absent, and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A candidate without start.sh produced a recorded contract-missing gate failure.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The green candidate served a page without sauna; gate-attempt-failed recorded identity-probe-failed.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The builder wrote its red marker after exit; the gate copy passed and its install digest matched the regenerate digest.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: The repair effect named the first gate evidence root; the second builder saw the clean room, previous candidate and evidence, and writes to both mounts failed.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Three red candidates produced three builder launches and three gate failures; the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted, no file-verdicts effect was recorded, and the only model request was render.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The same researcher code branched on the item, producing a score only for 01-001; file-verdicts offered that item alone and file-score recorded 01-002 unreached, 1 of 2 passing.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: On a fresh retry, R-1 failed at fence and R-2 halted at checklist; readings five seconds later matched their earlier progress and effect results.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: Two consecutive run-progress readings of the passed run were identical.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The URL-checking probe passed only for the expected URL with the marker, and the gate and cycle passed.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The suite created and removed a directory within the candidate, the gate passed, and the install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The first self-check passed and recorded the full skipped-check text after SKIP.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio suite, probe and store check passed; gate recorded 30 seconds, one poll, answer on poll 1 and answered as the context, with no refusal and a passed cycle.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The probe recorded the absolute gate-room start.sh and 30 as its two arguments; its GATE_STORE was outside the gate room, matched the store-check argument, and its environment had no LOYLY_ keys.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio red suite produced suite-red; its recorded environment contained neither GATE_STORE nor LOYLY_ keys, and neither probe nor store check ran.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The failing stdio probe produced identity-probe-failed with its boot-budget message, and the store check did not run.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The failing store check produced identity-probe-failed with its event-7 message; the run failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio suite required the plan spec at its root-relative path and passed the gate; the installed and regenerated candidate digests matched.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With no store-check command, the run halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and recorded no gate effect.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs on one store differed only in store-check command text; their recorded passing first self-checks carried different harness digests.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: On a fresh retry, the linked slice was stamped, the derived checklist listed 01-001 and 01-002 with sources under 01-a, and the run concluded failed at regenerate rather than halting.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With PLAN_SLICES=02, the only stamp event was 02-001 and the derived checklist contained only 02-001.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Both builder invocations received three arguments including the configured image path; regenerate and repair each named builder-clojure and the same image digest.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A valid commit with builder-clojure configured but absent returned builder-image-missing; run-progress returned null and no builder was configured or launched.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Two runs passed on the same store; the second stamp recorded no new identities, and its scoreboard named C-1 as the previous cycle.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The identity probe sourced the marker from its adjacent cut configuration and passed against the HTTP candidate; the install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: On a fresh retry the command ran once in the project repo with the cut tree, candidate copy and empty evidence directory; its candidate digest matched install, no launch marker appeared, and gate recorded budget 10, 20 polls, answer 3 and the probe line.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command failed attempt 1 as suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair builder read its receipt but could not write it, and attempt 2 passed.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The gate command produced three seam-answered-before-boot refusals, each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The unrecognized gate command result halted at gate with the specified detail; there was no gate or fail-cycle effect and no concluded cycle.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The no-command run’s digest equaled SHA-256 of config bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order; the no-command, gate-a and gate-b runs recorded three distinct harness digests.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: The cycle passed; Grain event intervals placed each of the eleven effect results inside its matching named leaf of the run or its child, and the reference store check passed.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The HTTP server returned 503 for its first three requests; the gate passed on poll 5 of 20 with a 10-second budget, and attempt 1 reported margin 15.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: The cycle passed on attempt 2; Grain intervals placed each attempt’s install, self-check and gate in separate gate-attempt.v1 child ticks, with repair 2 in attempt 1’s tick.

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: A copy launched from a temporary directory outside any .pi tree passed its gate and completed the cycle; the temporary root was removed after shutdown.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The passed run filed 1 of 2 verdicts as pass, with booked and no receipt as evidence; Grain recorded scores 1.0 and 0.0 in separate grade.v1 child ticks.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The first judge request contained E-ONE; neither the second researcher request nor the second judge request contained it.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: On a fresh retry the first researcher request contained the scenario, fixture seam and event model; its shell reported Linux, the item’s grading room containing config, plan, probe and candidate, and only that room under its parent.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The judge gave 01-002 a level and feedback without reasoning; only 01-001 had a Grain judge score and progress score, and the filed measurement marked 01-002 unreached.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: The unapproved actual rubric digest halted the run at grader with refused-before-the-cycle and the digest as detail; no self-check, fence or builder followed.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Both researcher requests failed; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the cycle failed at score for score-stage-failed with no subsequent builder.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: After the runner and sleeping builder were stopped, restarting on the same store resumed to a passed cycle; the builder log showed the same session identity twice and the initial effects each appeared once.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The first instruction file was exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the repair file appended a single paragraph naming the previous-candidate and gate-evidence paths.

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The stub model returned HTTP 400 to both render requests; the run halted at render for effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate, fail-cycle or cycle, and the empty builder was never launched.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: While the builder slept, run-progress showed running, a tick ID, completed fence and render nodes, and regenerate running last.
